records.subject: Checking in on Clearwater Partners' setup
records.body:
Hi Maya,

How's Wrenfield treating you this week? If there's a specific workflow you're trying to replicate from your old tool, I'm happy to help map it over.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

records.subject: Getting your team organized in Wrenfield
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Looking to get more out of Wrenfield? Inviting your teammates is the single biggest thing that makes it click.

Warmly,
Elena Kelly

records.subject: You're in -- let's get Clearwater Partners set up
records.body:
Hi Maya,

Welcome to Wrenfield. If you're bringing a team along, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time, and seats can be added any time from Account Settings.

I'm around if you need anything.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: Account is 6 days old with no first project, no invite, no key milestone despite onboarding call held [calendar:561f6193] and three outreaches [email:a3c27674, email:4a95a330, email:86a2391c] with zero customer replies. Silence after a live call suggests low momentum, though Pro plan and 8 days left leave some chance.

draft.subject: Picking up where our onboarding call left off
draft.body:
Hi Maya,

Thanks again for making time for our onboarding call last week. I wanted to check in, since I know getting started in a new tool can slip down the list during a busy stretch.

In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so getting that first project shaped is usually the thing that makes everything else fall into place.

Would a short call this week help? I'm glad to walk through your first project with you and answer anything that's come up since we spoke.

Best,
Priya
